## Requirements (from spec)
R1. `audit_structural` connector: agency audit exports → **structural aggregates only**, no per-search/per-plate row anywhere (§18.1) — SIG-INGEST-046.
R2. Audit `Camera Count` → **independent count claim** (active_device_count basis, genre audit_log), reconciled vs other counts by P08.2 (reconcile_counts), never merged — SIG-INGEST-035/046.
R3. `SharedNetworks.csv` → **configured access edges**, directional, blank cells negative, single-snapshot `valid_from_kind='unknown'`; asymmetry via P08.2 reconcile_sharing (§29.3) — SIG-ONTO-042/044.
R4. `***` redaction distinguished from empty — a redacted cell is a distinct recorded state — SIG-INGEST-046.
R5. Four audit source types (organization_audit, network_audit, portal_public_audit, event_log) recorded, non-interchangeable, each carries source-type provenance, not silently unioned — §23.7.
R6. UsageAggregate rows landed (record_kind rows); does NOT build the DuckDB/Parquet substrate (P12.1).

## Cross-cutting invariants
- Append-only/provenance (P1–P3): raw_value preserved, no is_current/authoritative.
- No plate/trip/per-person storage; officer-naming excluded by aggregates-only.
- Licence gate: source rights resolved; export gate not broken.
- Additive/back-compat: no break to prior wire names/schema.
- Reproducibility (SIG-INGEST-003): post-capture pure; only deterministic rows in stream (sharing/count findings owned by P08.2, kept out of L1).

## Acceptance criteria → test (matrix)
- AC1 no per-search/per-plate row → test_no_per_search_or_per_plate_row_is_produced; schema guard assert_no_per_row_output
- AC2 Camera Count independent count claim → test_camera_count_is_an_independent_count_claim; test_camera_count_reconciled_not_merged_via_p08_2
- AC3 SharedNetworks edges configured/directional/blanks-negative → test_sharednetworks_edges_*; test_blank_sharing_cells_are_negatives; asymmetry via P08.2
- AC4 *** ≠ empty → test_redaction_is_distinguished_from_empty
- AC5 four source types non-interchangeable → test_four_audit_source_types_not_interchangeable
- AC6 phase gate → make check green; traceability + risk register + ADR

## Out of scope (scope-creep guard)
- flock_portal API connector / compartment / snapshot change-detection / ai_training (P11.1)
- UsageAggregate DuckDB/Parquet substrate, small-cell suppression, UUID+period join (P12.1)
- access-path closure / three-edge inference (P12.2)
- sharing-edge reconciliation LOGIC (P08.2) — consumed, not reimplemented

## Design decisions
- New source `agency_audit_export` (records_channel, MIRROR, public_terms_only, CC0-1.0 public records; attribution+terms_url set). Tests flip ingestion_permitted like other connector tests.
- Connector `connectors.audit_structural`, vocab `data/audit_structural_vocab.toml`, registered in __init__.
- CSV parsing mirrors atlas.parse_csv. Per audit source type, column aliases in vocab.
- Aggregation happens in extract → only aggregate/count/sharing/lifecycle records leave; per-search rows purely transient. normalize/load run assert_no_per_row_output guard.
- Camera Count → reconcile.model.CountClaim(basis="active", genre="audit_log"); reconcile_camera_counts seam → reconcile.counts.reconcile_counts (P08.2).
- Sharing → reconcile.sharing.SharingObservation → reconcile_sharing (P08.2); only edges enter L1.
- _stamp records source_id + vocab_version + audit_source_type + source-agency provenance; compartment decided per-source by licence gate (like records.py), not pinned.
